title: The Light and Darkness of the Spear Hero
paragraphs: Then, based on Trash’s testimony, we set out to rescue Ren. Apparently, Ren had been forcibly transferred from Seven Island to a research facility near Melromarc.
Why was Ren, who had been stripped of the Four Holy Swords, kept alive? It seems it was all part of the plan Takt and the others were going to carry out after they’d taken us down.
“Ugh… Where am I…?”
Ren, who had been lying in a bed at the infirmary, regained consciousness and turned his face toward us.
“Are you okay, Ren?”
“That face… Ah, it’s Naofumi. It’s been a while since that day… Long time no see.”
“Yeah…”
Ren looks at me.
“Motoyasu is here too? So… does that mean I was rescued?”
As usual, Ren seems to have immediately grasped his situation. He must have been aware that he’d been held captive by Takt.
“That’s right.”
“Yeah… the sword that was taken from you is back in your hands, too.”
“I see…”
Ren raised his hand, seemingly relieved that the sword was back in his possession, but when he looked at that hand, his expression turned grim. And no wonder.
“This hand…”
“Yeah… It’s all because of Takt and his remnants. I’m sorry… for dragging you into our mess.”

That’s right. Ren, who had his sword stolen by Takt, was nearly killed by him—though thanks to Trash’s suggestion, he was somehow captured alive—but he ended up being turned into a test subject for the White-Coated Pigs.

Unable to activate the sword’s protective barrier because the sword was gone… his body was tampered with. Right now, Ren has distorted, Filolial-sama-like wings sprouting from his back, and what appear to be bird-like corrosive marks remain on his limbs.
“No… I’m partly to blame for letting myself get captured so easily…”
Ren seems to be responding while still in a dazed state.
“I know it’s hard, but I’ll ask someone who knows this kind of technology to fix you… For now, I want you to rest your body as much as you can.”
“…Thank you. Later… let’s talk again. I want to hear the details, and it seems we’ll have to work together on what comes next.”
“Yeah…”
And with that, Ren quietly drifted off to sleep.

Upon questioning Takt and his remaining followers, it seems they had planned to send Ren—who had been infected by the Filolial—to the Melromarc region, where people were likely to know him, to have him run amok there. Their intention was to use this to portray the Filolial as an evil monster capable of corrupting and tormenting even a Hero. And it seems Takt intended to encounter Ren, defeat him, and then, by having Ren—who had barely regained his human consciousness—hand over the Sacred Weapon, take his place as the Sword Hero.
Even though he’d already stolen the sword, mind you. That’s just too blatant.
“Take Ren to Rat-san’s place…”
At Father’s words, the healer nodded, and it was decided that Ren would be transported to Faubrey. Takt’s plan is riddled with countless flaws—and is utterly appalling.
And the mop-up of Takt’s remnants continues.
“Boo-boo-boo!”
“It’s too late now! Serves you right! May you all suffer in hell and die!”

And so… just as we were about to capture those Takt remnants—those pigs—reset their levels, and take them away… we came across a scene where members of the Takt Victims’ Association were hurling insults at the swine.

Ah, of course, it also had the air of a public execution, and passersby were throwing stones at those Takt remnants. Given the global upheaval caused by the Takt remnants, no one is condemning the act of throwing stones.

That’s only natural. They horribly modified Filolial-sama and made her attack the entire world. Above all, they murdered countless Seven-Star Heroes. There’s no way the anger of the people who learned of this could subside so easily.
“Bububuhi!?”
“Bububububu! Boo-boo!”
“Bubububuhi-bu!”
Even after being pelted with stones, those pigs are still saying something to the victims’ association. Well, it’s probably just more nonsense anyway.
“Huh? What are you even talking about now!　You lot had a field day at Takt’s place, didn’t you! Do you have any idea how I felt?! Die in agony! King Faubrey is just what you deserve!”

The man who told us that Takt’s remnants were hiding out on Seven Island is cursing at the two pigs while making a hand gesture of contempt. Those are his ex-wife and ex-daughter, aren’t they? Unfortunately, I can’t tell them apart from the other pigs.
“Wow… to be able to say something like that in that state… I can see why he’s angry.”
“What did they say, exactly?”

“Oh, yeah. ‘We’re victims who were deceived! Otherwise, Takt told us he’d kill you! Look, if you just bow your head, we can go back to our old lives, so hurry up and save us!’ That’s what the ex-wife said, and the daughter followed up with, ‘Daddy! You’re still my only daddy! We didn’t do anything wrong!’ And she’s saying this even though it’s been confirmed that she was actively working alongside the perpetrators.”
“There’s no hope for them. Without a doubt… they’re pigs that make me want to vomit.”
We’d better ship them off to Faubrey’s pig farm as soon as possible. That would also be for the sake of those who suffered at Takt’s hands.

…Now I can understand how they feel. The resentment of the Filolial-sama who were killed before they were even born… there’s no way they could ever forgive Takt. Though they’re of a different kind, they harbor a similar rage.
I’ll approach the male victim and speak to him.
“Ah! It’s the Spear Hero! Thank you so much for catching these guys! We’re feeling so relieved!”
“I’m glad to hear that. So, what should we do with these guys? Should we slaughter them right here? I’ll do whatever you want.”
“Ooogggghhhhhh!? Oink oink!? Oooggg!”
“Oink oink! Ooooggg!”
After two pigs let out cries of fear, the one that looked like a young pig seemed to wink at me in a strange pose. Instantly, the male victim’s face twisted in disgust.
“No… I wouldn’t be satisfied if I killed them right away. I have to make them suffer properly… don’t you think? Spear Hero, you mustn’t listen to what these creatures are saying.”
“Rest assured. I don’t even know what they’re saying anyway.”
At my reply, the male victim let out a sigh of relief, while the pigs are oinking away and spraying drool in my direction. Shut up—you’re going to get me dirty!
“More importantly, since everyone from the Victims’ Association is gathered here, this is perfect timing. I wanted to have a little chat with you all.”
“Wh—what is it, Hero?”
“During this commotion, Takt—who had been dead—reappeared thanks to some astonishing technology, and we managed to capture him alive.”
“Yes, I’ve heard about that. What an eerie guy. I thought it was for the best that the heroes put him in his place… but what’s this all about?”
“Don’t you get it? I absolutely cannot forgive what Takt did this time, and I’ve sworn to make him pay for it.”

As soon as I said that, the victim seemed to realize something. After all, it’s common knowledge that I love Filolial-sama. Furthermore, this victim surely understands what Takt was doing to Filolial-sama. The victim’s expression was a mix of sympathy and confusion. So I said:
“Regarding that matter, I’d like to ask if you lot also want to help make Takt pay for what he’s done.”
“W-well… Absolutely!”
“Me too!”
“Please count me in!”
“We can get our revenge!”
“We can make that guy suffer even more!”
“This means we’ll be able to… greet tomorrow morning!”
The victims come bustling over to me, all chattering away. That’s right… we have to make Takt and his pig-like cronies suffer miserably before we kill them. Our revenge has only just begun.
Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha ha ha! Anyone who holds a grudge against Takt, follow my lead!
“Naofumi, aren’t you going to join them over there?”
“Uh… I think I’ll pass. I’d probably end up having nightmares or something.”
“The ‘Wild’ Naofumi would probably be happy to join in.”
“As for the ‘me’ from another world, that’s one thing, but I’d rather pass on this one.”

Father and Rival are saying all sorts of things, but this is a done deal. Then, to ensure that Takt and his pig-like minions received their just deserts, we consulted with King Faubrey and proceeded to torture and execute them.

Along the way, some of the victims did end up backing out… but we made Takt taste the hell of this world; even after that, we didn’t just kill him—we broke his spirit, tormented him, and then killed him in the most gruesome way possible. Father, who’d only seen the written report of the proceedings, furrowed his brow, but he couldn’t back down.
“We haven’t killed him enough yet. When the loop restarts, I’ll have to kill him in a gruesome way again! I won’t just kill him off easily!”
“A-are you still not satisfied after punishing him this much…? What he did was absolutely terrible, but… I can’t help but feel a little sorry for him.”
“How should I put it… Takt ended up being hated by exactly the kind of person he shouldn’t have.”
“That’s certainly true. Earning the hatred of someone with the Loop ability… Still, if you knew what Takt had been doing, you’d probably end up sympathizing with Motoyasu-kun, wouldn’t you?”
“As a case of reaping what he sowed, Takt will have to keep paying the price from now on.”
“I hope that every Takt who meets Motoyasu from now on will find a peaceful end,”
Father says, offering some sort of prayer. You really should rein in that kindness a bit, Father! Ah, what a merciful father he is.

In any case, and so the turmoil caused by the remnants—including Takt—began to subside. Shieldfreeden was also able to obtain permission to use a portion of the assets confiscated from Takt toward compensation. …Though they’re not happy about it, they’ve begun to gradually recover under Rival’s management. It seems the groundwork for paying the full compensation has largely been laid.
All that remains… are the Filolial-sama who had been raised by Takt and his pig-like minions.

After capturing them, stripping Takt and the pigs of their rights to the monster crests, and setting them free, Yuki-chan and I took care of them in various ways. Immediately after their capture, the Filolial-sama still trusted their masters—the Pigs and Takt—as their “owners,” but I was told they had gradually come to realize that Takt and his cronies didn’t truly care for them; instead, they were being used as tools for revenge, forced to run amok, and ultimately intended to be killed. I heard this heart-wrenching story through Yuki-chan.
But those worries are now a thing of the past. After all, I will treat Filolial-sama—who was warped by Takt—with all the love I can muster.

And so, I continued to care for Filolial-sama and the others in this way. As I became their new master and looked after them, the warped Filolial-samas gradually returned to being normal Queens and Kings, and more and more of them began to take on the form of angels. According to Father, they’ve been gradually opening their hearts after being touched by kindness.

As for how the world views Filolial-sama, while there was some confusion due to this recent upheaval, things worked out thanks to Father and the others declaring to the world that Takt was entirely to blame. It seems their credibility was further bolstered by the fact that Filolials—who serve under the great Filolial-sama—were protecting people all over the country. Truly… this was the most terrifying incident of all the loops so far.
As part of my job, my responsibilities for caring for the Filolial-sama have increased in this way. In any case, I feel every day that the world is gradually moving in a positive direction.
It was on such a peaceful morning. After finishing breakfast, I was sitting alone with Father on the terrace in Siltvelt, gazing out at the townscape.
“I suppose the only major problem for the time being is the waves now, isn’t it?”
“From what I recall, that’s correct.”

Ren’s treatment has made significant progress, and it seems he’s recovered enough to return to duty in the near future. We’ll have to have a serious talk with him then. Well, it’s anyone’s guess how much of what we say Ren will actually listen to. That said, since he lost to Takt, he’ll probably listen to us to some extent.

As for Trash, according to the Queen and her Finacée, he’s been keeping a low profile. The Queen, her Finacée, and even Rival all said that saving the Queen’s life made a big difference. We still need to be on guard—you never know when he might stab us in the back—but I hear he’s been having various conversations with the Tiger Girl as well.
Since that incident the other day, Sakura-chan has been visiting her Finacée more often.

By the way, Panda was chosen as one of the Seven Holy Heroes of the Hammer. After overcoming his grandfather’s grueling training and inheriting the large pipe, he obtained the title the moment he touched the Seven Holy Weapons of the Hammer.

Since the Claw and the Hammer—two of the Seven Holy Weapons—are often used in the kingdoms of Demi-Humans and Beastmen, it’s said that Siltvelt takes great pride in having a bearer of these weapons among its own. Including Zou, our standing is becoming increasingly solid.
“According to Motoyasu, the day when that crisis is resolved is drawing near… It’s been a very busy time, but I finally feel like I can see the light at the end of the tunnel.”
“Indeed.”
Since this was early in one of our previous loops, we faced various difficulties, but we’ve managed to sort them out. I suppose we can breathe a sigh of relief for now.
